user.title: Add an H10
user.description: Choose the ubisys H10 that will receive the room temperature.

assign.title: Connect a room sensor
assign.description: Choose a heating circuit on **{h10}** and the room sensor it should use. If the sensor runs on batteries, wake it immediately before you submit.

error.device_missing: The selected device or heating circuit is no longer available.
error.no_response: The device did not respond. Wake the room sensor and try again.
error.binding_rejected: The device rejected the Zigbee request. Check that both devices are still paired and try again.

abort.no_h10: No compatible ubisys H10 was found in ZHA.
abort.no_sensors: No compatible Zigbee room sensor was found in ZHA.
abort.no_free_circuits: All available circuits on this H10 already have an entry. Manage the existing entries under Devices & services.

check.title: Check connection
check.description:
**{assignment}**

Wake the room sensor before you continue. Home Assistant will read the sensor’s binding table and the temperature currently used by the H10.

check_result.title: Connection check
check_result.description:
**{assignment}**

Room temperature at the H10: **{temperature}**.

Warm the room sensor slightly and check again to see whether the H10 follows the change.

restore.title: Restore connection
restore.description:
**{assignment}**

Wake the room sensor before you continue. Home Assistant will set up the direct temperature binding again.

detach.title: Disconnect room sensor
detach.description:
**{assignment}**

Wake the room sensor before you continue. The H10 will stop receiving temperature reports from this sensor. To choose a different sensor, remove this entry after disconnecting and add the circuit again.

error.no_response: The device did not respond. Wake the room sensor and try again.
error.binding_rejected: The device rejected the Zigbee request. Check that both devices are still paired and try again.
error.binding_missing: The sensor’s binding table has no entry for this heating circuit. Use Restore connection to set it again.

abort.device_missing: The selected device or heating circuit is no longer available.
